(b) => (c) (proof lines 4385-4389): e: U -> G is a section of G -> U; 01KT gives closed immersion (separated case) and quasi-compact (quasi-separated case).

Recover properties of e as a section (proof lines 4385-4389).
Recover properties of the diagonal of R from e via the diagram lemma (proof lines 4392-4400).
